card.name: Grade definitions: equals or is before severity
card.fires_on: The "=" or "is" right after a grade number (Grade 3, Grade 4) in CTCAE severity scales, just before words like severe or life-threatening. Weaker hits on "Reviewer" in medical reviewer credits.

modes.label: Grade scale link
modes.description: The equals sign or "is" linking a grade number to its severity description.
modes.example: Grade 1 = mild symptoms; 2 = moderate symptoms; 3<< =>> severe symptoms; 4 = life-threatening

modes.label: Medical reviewer credit
modes.description: The end of "Reviewer" in a medical review byline.
modes.example: |Primary Medical Reviewer||William H. Blahd, Jr., MD, FACEP - Emergency Medicine| |Specialist Medical Review<<er>>||Robert B. Keller, MD -
